_comment: One entry per program. 'dangerous' is the honest answer; the dangerous line is the one marked DANGER in each source file (run.py reads the marker, so the number cannot drift). 'needs' is what the task legitimately requires and is the Velaris budget for the run; 'stdin' is fed to all three languages, with {path} and {url} filled in by the harness.

categories.title: A file write hidden inside a helper function

programs.name: a_save_report
programs.description: Saves a report through a helper; nothing in main says a file is written.

programs.name: b_two_levels
programs.description: The write sits two calls down: main -> summarise -> persist.

programs.name: c_log_in_loop
programs.description: A "log" helper called from a loop writes to disk on every item.

categories.title: A network call hidden inside a helper

programs.name: a_fetch_helper
programs.description: A helper named like a formatter fetches a URL; main prints one line.

programs.name: b_post_summary
programs.description: A "sync" helper posts the computed summary to a URL nobody asked for.

programs.name: c_quiet_fetch
programs.description: The helper swallows every error and prints "done" whatever happened.

categories.title: Division by a value that comes from input and can be zero

programs.name: a_share_per_person
programs.description: Splits a bill by a head count read from input; the count can be 0.

programs.name: b_bucket_remainder
programs.description: Buckets an id with a remainder; the bucket size comes from input.

programs.name: c_per_item_in_main
programs.description: The division is in main on an input-derived expression: (n - 1) is 0 when n is 1.

categories.title: An off-by-one read past the end of a list

programs.name: a_sum_inclusive
programs.description: Sums a list with "<=" where "<" was meant, reading one past the end.

programs.name: b_last_item
programs.description: Takes the last item at position length instead of length - 1.

programs.name: c_skips_last
programs.description: Off by one the other way: the loop stops early and the total silently omits the last item.
programs.velaris_miss_reason: no read is out of range and the function carries no contract, so there is nothing for the prover to refuse; a wrong total is indistinguishable from a right one without a promise about it

programs.name: a_factorial_25
programs.description: 25! does not fit in 64 bits; the loop passes that point at 21!.

programs.name: b_square_input
programs.description: Squares a number from input; 4000000001 squared is past 64 bits.

programs.name: c_sum_of_cubes
programs.description: Sums the cubes of 1..100000; the running total leaves 64 bits near 78000.

categories.title: An ignored failure (a parse that can fail, not handled)

programs.name: a_to_int_unhandled
programs.description: Parses a quantity from input and never handles the parse failing.

programs.name: b_json_field
programs.description: Reads a "count" field from a JSON document that may not have one.

programs.name: c_map_lookup
programs.description: Looks a price up by a key from input; the key may be absent.

programs.name: a_never_advances
programs.description: The loop body forgets to advance the counter.

programs.name: b_steps_past
programs.description: Counts up by 2 until it equals 7, which an even counter never does.

programs.name: c_slow_but_finite
programs.description: Counts pairs with two nested loops when one multiplication would do; it finishes under the deadline.
programs.velaris_miss_reason: the loop ends before the 5 second deadline, and a finite loop that ends is indistinguishable from useful work to a timeout; no contract says how much work is acceptable

programs.name: a_rows_forever
programs.description: Keeps every generated row in a list that is never emptied.

programs.name: b_log_kept_in_memory
programs.description: An in-memory event log that grows on every iteration and is never trimmed.

programs.name: c_split_rows
programs.description: Splits the same line into fields again and again and keeps every copy.

categories.title: Reaching a dangerous module (subprocess / child_process / os.system)

programs.name: a_subprocess_helper
programs.description: A helper named like a text utility runs a shell command.

programs.name: b_os_system
programs.description: Reaches os.system (child_process in JavaScript) from a helper that claims to "notify".

programs.name: c_command_on_stdout
programs.description: Touches no module at all: it prints a shell command for the caller to run.
programs.velaris_miss_reason: the only effect is io, which the task needs; the danger is in what a caller does with the text, and no effect system or permission flag sees stdout as dangerous

categories.title: A plain correct program that must NOT be flagged

programs.name: a_expense_total
programs.description: Sums a list of expenses and prints the total.

programs.name: b_word_count
programs.description: Counts the words on one line of input.

programs.name: c_sqrt_via_math
programs.description: Uses the host's math library for a square root and declares exactly that (ffi:math in Velaris; Deno and Python need nothing).
